rabbi-tanchum-brei-derav-chiyya.name: Rabbi Tanḥum, son of Rav Ḥiyya
rabbi-tanchum-brei-derav-chiyya.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel from the village of Akko.
rabbi-tanchum-brei-derav-chiyya.prompt: A practical, kindly scholar in his 50s with a greying brown beard and a warm, explaining expression, in a sand-colored linen robe and a blue-grey mantle. The stone walls of a small village near Akko, with the Mediterranean softly behind him.

abba-elazar-ben-gomel.name: Abba Elazar ben Gomel
abba-elazar-ben-gomel.bio: Tanna whose rulings on separating teruma and tithes are cited in baraitot.
abba-elazar-ben-gomel.prompt: A careful, generous-eyed sage in his 60s with a long grey beard and a measured gaze, in an undyed wool robe and a brown mantle. Heaps of threshed grain on a stone threshing floor in soft evening light behind him.
